title: A Main Recon (Standard)
description: From A Main, stand against the left wall near the green box. Aim the recon bolt high at the top-right of the arch opening, full charge. It lands mid-site and reveals defenders holding A site + CT.

title: B Site Recon from Market
description: From B Market, aim at the top edge of the B site arch / pizza gap with a half-charge and shoot. The bolt pops over the wall and scans site, catching defenders on site and default.

title: A Site Default Wall
description: Place the wall from A Main across the site entrance to CT, covering Heaven. Cut the wall on entry so your team pushes through the left gap, isolating one angle at a time.

title: Mid One-Way Smoke
description: From mid, place the orb slightly above eye level on the market side of mid so it clips the corner of the arch. Enemies crossing mid can't see you, but you can see their feet.

title: B Site Execute Smokes
description: For a B execute, smoke the back of B site (garden side) and the elbow/CT. Drop a third on the main entrance if your team is splitting from B Long. Play the post-plant from back site.

title: B Long Info Bolt
description: From B Long, shoot the recon bolt at the top corner of the metal beam over the tube. It lands behind the tube and scans the elbow + back site, giving your entry team early info.

title: B Back One-Way
description: Hold the orb at the corner of the B back-site wall near the truck. Enemies pushing B Long must cross your one-way while you hold from the truck corner.

title: B Site Nanoswarm (Default plant)
description: Pre-place a Nanoswarm on the default plant spot on B site. When you hear the plant or see a defender step on it, trigger for an easy multi-kill or defuse delay.

title: A Long Default Recon
description: From A Long (sewer side), aim the bolt at the top-left of the A site wall, just above the boxes. It scans the entire site including Heaven, CT and default.

title: C Long / Garage Recon
description: From C Long, line up on the right edge of the window frame and shoot a full-charge bolt high toward the back site. It lands near the C site corner and reveals garage + back site defenders.

title: C Site Wall (Garage cut)
description: Wall from C Long across the site entrance, clipping the garage opening. Push through the right gap; cut the wall once on site so CT and back site are blocked.

title: Mid Top One-Way
description: Place the orb on the mid-top crate so it sits slightly above head height when viewed from mid. Attackers pushing through mid can't see you holding from the stairs.

title: A Site Execute (Ramp + Heaven)
description: Smoke Heaven (tower) and the back of site from A Main/Ramp, then execute with utility. Molotov the default plant spot to flush a planted defender.

title: A Main Recon to Heaven
description: From A Main, aim the bolt up at the tower roof edge and fire at half charge. The bolt scans Heaven and the A site back corner — essential info before your execute.

title: C Site Wall (Waterfall gap)
description: Wall from C Main across the site, cutting the waterfall side so your team pushes right. Stand near the left wall and stretch the wall full length to cover back site.

title: B Site Execute
description: Smoke the back of B site and the cubby/CT angle, then execute with your initiator's flashes. Follow up with a molly on the default plant to clear a lurking defender.

title: A Site Recon (Belt)
description: From A Main, shoot the recon bolt at the top corner of the belt / rafters opening. It lands on the site and scans belt, default, and the back of site.

title: B Site One-Way (Yellow)
description: Place the orb above head height near yellow so defenders holding from the site can see attackers crossing B main while staying hidden.

title: A Main Pyramids Recon
description: From A Main, fire a full-charge bolt over the pyramids toward the back of site. It reveals defenders holding pyramids, CT, and the corner behind the container.

title: B Site Wall (Long)
description: Wall from B Main across the site, cutting the mid-door side. Push through the gap nearest the wall to isolate the site retake angles one at a time.

title: A Site Wall (Dugout cut)
description: Wall from A Main across the site opening, clipping the dugout side. Execute through the right gap and cut the wall to block CT once your team is on site.

title: B Site Execute
description: Smoke the back of B site and the connector (CT), then flash through with your initiator. Post-plant, hold from B main and rotate off the spike.

title: A Site Wall (Market cut)
description: Wall from A Main across the site, cutting the market/CT side. Push through the gap near market and cut the wall to lock off CT rotations.

title: B Site Recon from Mid
description: From B Mid/Elbow, fire the recon bolt high toward the back of B site. It scans the default plant and the corners behind the site boxes before you execute.

title: B Site Turret Watch
description: Place the turret on the B site boxes facing market so it tags enemies crossing the mid-market link, giving you early rotation info while you anchor from site.

title: A Short Wall
description: Wall across A Short (from the lamps) to the site corner. Push with your duelist through the left gap while your team flashes from A Short entrance.

title: C Site Default Nanoswarm
description: Pre-place a Nanoswarm on the C default plant spot. Trigger it on plant or when a defender steps on it to secure a free kill or a strong defuse delay.

title: B Site Execute
description: Smoke the back of B site (belt area) and the kitchen/CT side, then execute with your initiator. Molly the default plant to clear the corner plant.
